fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have at least one blank page.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener al menos 6 meses de validez desde la llegada y al menos una página en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least one blank page.

entry.en: Tourist e-visas can be obtained in advance and are valid for up to 3 months.
entry.es: Se puede obtener un e-visa turístico por adelantado, válido hasta 3 meses.
entry.quote: getting an e-visa in advance can help to prevent delays, tourist e-visas are valid for up to 3 months

entry.en: Approved airports have kiosks where a physical visa on arrival costs 30 US dollars, cash only, valid for up to 30 days.
entry.es: Los aeropuertos autorizados tienen quioscos donde la visa a la llegada cuesta 30 dólares, solo en efectivo, válida hasta 30 días.
entry.quote: approved airports have kiosks before you reach the immigration counters where you can buy a physical visa for 30 US dollars (cash only). Visas on arrival are valid for up to 30 days.

entry.en: You do not need to buy a visa from an agent in the airport, as agents often charge more than 30 US dollars.
entry.es: No necesitas comprar la visa a un agente en el aeropuerto, que suele cobrar más de 30 dólares.
entry.quote: You do not need to buy a visa from an agent. Agents often charge more than the required 30 US dollars.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You can bring up to 5,000 Egyptian pounds in or out, and must declare foreign currency worth more than 10,000 US dollars on arrival.
entry.es: Puedes entrar o sacar hasta 5.000 libras egipcias y debes declarar divisas por más de 10.000 dólares al llegar.
entry.quote:
You can bring up to 5,000 Egyptian pounds into or out of Egypt.

You must declare foreign currency worth more than 10,000 US dollars on arrival

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Egypt, including in places visited by foreign nationals.
safety.es: Es probable que haya intentos de atentados terroristas en Egipto, incluso en lugares visitados por extranjeros.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks could be indiscriminate including in places visited by foreign nationals.

safety.en: Foreign nationals involved in political activity or activities critical of the government, including negative social media comments, may be at risk of detention.
safety.es: Los extranjeros que participen en actividad política o críticas al gobierno, incluso comentarios negativos en redes, pueden ser detenidos.
safety.quote: Foreign nationals involved in any political activity or activities critical of the government may be at risk of detention. This includes posting negative comments on social media.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to North Sinai and to within 20km of the Egypt-Libya border.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje al Sinaí del Norte y a menos de 20 km de la frontera Egipto-Libia.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to North Sinai Governate due to continuing criminal activity and terrorist attacks on police and security forces that have resulted in deaths.

safety.en: Female travellers should be cautious when travelling alone, particularly at night in taxis.
safety.es: Las mujeres deben tener precaución al viajar solas, sobre todo de noche en taxis.
safety.quote: Female travellers should exercise caution when travelling alone, particularly at night, in taxis.

safety.en: Scammers and touts sometimes target foreign nationals in tourist areas.
safety.es: En zonas turísticas, estafadores y vendedores insistentes a veces abordan a los extranjeros.
safety.quote: Be cautious in tourist areas, where scammers and touts sometimes target foreign nationals.

safety.en: Accidents are common because of variable road conditions and dangerous driving, and driving outside main cities and resorts at night is discouraged.
safety.es: Los accidentes son comunes por el estado de las vías y la conducción peligrosa; no se debe conducir de noche fuera de ciudades y resorts.
safety.quote: Accidents are common because of variable road conditions, dangerous driving and poor traffic law enforcement. Do not drive outside main cities and resorts at night.

health.en: Make sure your travel insurance or the dive company covers air or sea rescue, which can cost more than 4,000 US dollars per hour.
health.es: Asegúrate de que tu seguro o la empresa de buceo cubra rescates aéreos o marítimos, que pueden costar más de 4.000 dólares por hora.
health.quote: Make sure your travel insurance, or the tour or dive company, will cover the costs for any air or sea rescue, which can cost more than 4,000 US dollars per hour.

health.en: Some hotel doctors have overcharged for treatment and medicines, and pharmacies outside hotels often charge less.
health.es: Algunos médicos de hoteles han cobrado de más; las farmacias fuera de los hoteles suelen ser más baratas.
health.quote: Some hotel doctors have overcharged for treatment and medicines. Pharmacies outside hotels will often supply medication at lower prices.

health.en: Some prescribed and over-the-counter medicines may be controlled substances in Egypt and may need permission from the Ministry of Health before arrival.
health.es: Algunos medicamentos pueden ser sustancias controladas en Egipto y requerir permiso previo del Ministerio de Salud.
health.quote: Some prescribed and over-the-counter medicines may be controlled substances in Egypt. You may need permission from Egypt’s Ministry of Health before you arrive.

health.en: Egyptian tap water is generally considered safe by most locals but will often make travellers ill, and bottled water is widely available.
health.es: El agua del grifo la consideran segura la mayoría de locales, pero suele enfermar a los viajeros; hay agua embotellada por todas partes.
health.quote: Egyptian tap water is generally considered safe by most locals, but will often make travellers ill.

health.en: Private hospitals may refuse treatment if insurance does not cover the costs or a large sum has not been deposited.
health.es: Los hospitales privados pueden negarse a tratar si el seguro no cubre los costos o no se deposita una suma considerable.
health.quote: Hospitals will not treat patients if travel insurance does not cover the costs or if a large sum of money has not been deposited with the hospital.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Egypt.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Egipto.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Egypt.

help.en: Egypt's emergency numbers are ambulance 123, fire 180, police 122 and tourist police 126.
help.es: Los números de emergencia de Egipto son ambulancia 123, bomberos 180, policía 122 y policía turística 126.

help.en: To report a crime, call the tourist police on 126, as it is hard to prosecute later if you do not report before leaving Egypt.
help.es: Para denunciar un delito llama a la policía turística al 126; después de salir de Egipto es difícil procesarlo.
help.quote: To report a crime, phone the tourist police on 126. If you do not report a crime before you leave Egypt, it will be difficult to prosecute later.

help.en: If your passport is lost or stolen, tell the police immediately and get a police report, which you need to transfer visa stamps.
help.es: Si pierdes el pasaporte, avisa a la policía y obtén un informe policial, necesario para transferir los sellos de visa.
help.quote: If your passport is lost or stolen, tell the police immediately and get a police report. You will need a police report to get visa stamps transferred to your replacement passport.

getting_in.en: Cairo International Airport is the primary entry point and the hub of the national carrier EgyptAir.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de El Cairo es el principal punto de entrada y el centro de EgyptAir.
getting_in.quote: Cairo International Airport is the primary entry point and the hub of the national carrier,  Egyptair.

getting_in.en: Hurghada and Sharm El Sheikh airports are cheap options for budget tourists staying on the Red Sea.
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos de Hurghada y Sharm El Sheikh son opciones económicas para turistas en el Mar Rojo.
getting_in.quote: Hurghada International Airport is a major airport for budget tourists coming into Egypt and staying along the Red Sea.

getting_in.en: Ferries run regularly from Aqaba to Nuweiba on the Sinai peninsula, bypassing Israel.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris regulares de Áqaba a Nuweiba, en el Sinaí, que evitan Israel.
getting_in.quote: Ferries run regularly from Aqaba across to Nuweiba on the Sinai peninsula, bypassing Israel and the sometimes complicated border arrangements.

getting_in.en: The Egypt-Sudan land crossings at Qustul and Argeen have almost no infrastructure and no visa on arrival.
getting_in.es: Los pasos terrestres con Sudán, Qustul y Argeen, casi no tienen infraestructura y no emiten visa a la llegada.
getting_in.quote: There is almost no infrastructure at these crossings, and it is no longer possible to obtain a visa on arrival at these locations.

getting_around.en: Overland journeys between cities are often long and not altogether safe, while a good domestic air network makes flying a good option.
getting_around.es: Los viajes por tierra entre ciudades suelen ser largos y poco seguros; la red aérea interna es buena y volar suele convenir.
getting_around.quote: Overland journeys between cities in Egypt are often long, hot, bumpy, dusty, and not altogether safe. There is a good domestic air network, and advance fares are not expensive, so flying internally is often a good option.

getting_around.en: Trains between Cairo and Alexandria and between Luxor and Aswan are excellent but relatively expensive, and there are no trains to the Red Sea resorts or Siwa.
getting_around.es: Los trenes El Cairo-Alejandría y Luxor-Asuán son excelentes pero caros; no hay trenes a los resorts del Mar Rojo ni a Siwa.
getting_around.quote: There are no trains to the Red Sea resorts or to Siwa oasis.

getting_around.en: Foreigners must buy foreigner tickets for Egyptian trains, around USD 110 between Cairo and Luxor.
getting_around.es: Los extranjeros deben comprar boletos para extranjeros en los trenes, unos 110 USD entre El Cairo y Luxor.
getting_around.quote: foreigners now must buy foreigner tickets to ride Egyptian trains. Expect to pay around USD $110 between Cairo and Luxor, for example.

getting_around.en: The Cairo-Luxor-Aswan sleeper is run by Abela Trains, and tickets must be bought from them online.
getting_around.es: El tren cama El Cairo-Luxor-Asuán lo opera Abela Trains y los boletos se compran en línea con ellos.
getting_around.quote: The sleeper service Cairo-Luxor-Aswan is run by Abela Trains, a private company. Buy tickets online from them

getting_around.en: Travelers are warned against buying bus tickets from touts, as smaller companies are sometimes unlicensed.
getting_around.es: Se advierte no comprar boletos de autobús a revendedores, pues las compañías pequeñas a veces no tienen licencia.
getting_around.quote: Beware buying tickets from bus touts on the street or outside your hotel. The smaller companies are sometimes unlicensed and can cut corners with safety.

getting_around.en: White metered taxis are generally advisable, as black and white taxis usually involve haggling at the end of the ride.
getting_around.es: Se aconsejan los taxis blancos con taxímetro, pues en los blanquinegros suele regatearse al final.
getting_around.quote: It is generally advisable to take white taxis that use the meter because the black and white taxis usually involve haggling at the end of the ride

money.en: The local currency is the Egyptian pound (EGP), divided into 100 piastres.
money.es: La moneda local es la libra egipcia (EGP), dividida en 100 piastras.
money.quote: The local currency is the Egyptian pound (ISO code: EGP), which is divided into 100 piastres.

money.en: You can withdraw local money with a Mastercard or Visa card from many ATMs, and ATMs are ubiquitous in cities.
money.es: Puedes retirar dinero con Mastercard o Visa en muchos cajeros, que abundan en las ciudades.
money.quote: You can withdraw local money with a Mastercard or Visa card from many ATMs all over Egypt. ATMs are ubiquitous in the cities and probably the best option.

money.en: Visa and MasterCard are accepted at many frequented places, but American Express and Diners Club are readily accepted only at bigger hotels in Cairo and tourist-area restaurants.
money.es: Visa y MasterCard se aceptan en muchos sitios, pero American Express y Diners solo en grandes hoteles de El Cairo y restaurantes turísticos.
money.quote: Visa and MasterCard credit and debit cards are accepted at many frequented places, but only bigger hotels or restaurants in Cairo and restaurants in tourist areas will readily accept American Express and Diners Club cards as payment.

money.en: Egyptians do not tip at restaurants, though a service charge may be added at fancier restaurants.
money.es: Los egipcios no dan propina en restaurantes, aunque en los más elegantes puede añadirse un cargo por servicio.
money.quote: Egyptians do not tip at restaurants, nor do restaurant owners expect them, though at fancier restaurants a service charge may be added to your bill.

money.en: When shopping in markets or with street vendors, bargaining is expected.
money.es: En mercados y con vendedores ambulantes se espera regatear.
money.quote: When shopping in markets or dealing with street vendors, remember to bargain. This is a part of the salesmanship game that both parties are expected to engage in.

money.en: Before leaving Egypt, convert your currency, as money changers elsewhere give far worse rates for Egyptian pounds if they accept them at all.
money.es: Antes de salir de Egipto convierte tu dinero, pues en otros países las libras egipcias se cambian a peor tasa, si las aceptan.
money.quote: Before leaving Egypt, even if travelling to neighbouring countries in the Middle East, convert your currency to euros, British pounds or US dollars.

etiquette.en: Egypt is predominantly Islamic, so respect local traditions, customs, laws and religions, especially during Ramadan or at religious areas.
etiquette.es: Egipto es mayoritariamente islámico: respeta tradiciones, costumbres, leyes y religión, sobre todo en Ramadán o lugares religiosos.
etiquette.quote: Egypt is predominantly an Islamic country. Take care to respect local traditions, customs, laws and religions. Seek to avoid offence, especially during Ramadan or when you visit religious areas.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan it is culturally insensitive to eat, drink or smoke in public during daylight hours.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán es culturalmente insensible comer, beber o fumar en público a la luz del día.
etiquette.quote: it is culturally insensitive to eat, drink or smoke in public during daylight hours.

etiquette.en: Dress modestly, especially in rural areas, mosques and souqs.
etiquette.es: Viste con modestia, sobre todo en zonas rurales, mezquitas y zocos.
etiquette.quote: Dress modestly, especially in rural areas, mosques and souqs (markets).

etiquette.en: Couples showing physical affection in public is frowned upon, though holding hands is generally fine.
etiquette.es: Las muestras de afecto físico en público se ven mal, aunque tomarse de la mano suele estar bien.
etiquette.quote: Couples showing physical affection in public is frowned upon. Holding hands is generally fine.

etiquette.en: Do not enter a mosque wearing shoes, sandals or boots, though you can keep socks on.
etiquette.es: No entres a una mezquita con zapatos, sandalias o botas; puedes dejarte los calcetines.
etiquette.quote: Do not enter a mosque wearing any type of shoes, sandals, slippers, boots as this is very disrespectful.

etiquette.en: It is illegal to take photos of or near military property, and you need an Egyptian citizen's written permission before photographing them.
etiquette.es: Es ilegal fotografiar propiedad militar o sus cercanías, y se necesita permiso escrito de un egipcio para fotografiarlo.
etiquette.quote: It is illegal to take photos of, or near, military property. This includes the Suez Canal.

connectivity.en: Egypt has four mobile providers: Vodafone, Etisalat, We and Orange, with Vodafone having the widest 4G coverage.
connectivity.es: Egipto tiene cuatro operadores móviles: Vodafone, Etisalat, We y Orange; Vodafone tiene la mayor cobertura 4G.
connectivity.quote: The mobile phone providers are Vodafone, Etisalat, We and Orange.

connectivity.en: Local SIM cards are not recommended because of a 38.5% import tax on phones made abroad; an international eSIM or roaming SIM is suggested.
connectivity.es: No se recomiendan las SIM locales por un impuesto de importación de 38,5 % a celulares extranjeros; se sugiere eSIM o roaming.
connectivity.quote: To avoid this issue and avoid paying the tax, use an international travel eSIM or foregin SIM card with roaming enabled.

connectivity.en: Most coffee shops, restaurants and hotel lobbies provide free WiFi, but connections can be unsafe and under surveillance so a VPN is suggested.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de cafés, restaurantes y lobbies tienen WiFi gratis, pero puede ser inseguro y vigilado; se sugiere usar VPN.
connectivity.quote: Connections can be unsafe and under surveillance, try to use a proxy or VPN for your privacy.

phrases.quote: the best thing to say is the local variation of the Islamic form of greeting "es-salāmu-`alēku" which literally means "peace be upon you".
Other forms of greeting include "SàbâH el khēr" ("good morning")
simply "ma`a s-salāma", literally: "with safety" or "with wellness" which is used to mean to say "goodbye"
a polite la shukran (no thanks) helps a lot
